snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026!

Explore, loot, and shop keep your way through dimensions in this roguelite adventure with a twist.

Will’s journey continues as he rebuilds his shop, explores the shifting world of Tresna, and uncovers the mysteries waiting deep inside the Vault.

#IndieWorld #Moonlighter2 #NintendoSwitch2
